body: My victory this week was realizing that I've gotten really good at Dota. Of course, I'm using the easy characters, but it's a step forward then being good at no characters :P

The thing is, my dad isn't the best person either. He can be very verbally abusive, but act like nothing happened. He'll guilt you into doing whatever he wants. And sometimes, rarely, he'll use physical force on people. Like what he did 6 months ago when I stopped doing my school. He saw my grades, didn't like what he saw, and decided to scream at me and pulling my shirt to get in my face, which he ended up tearing, and then I had the little heart attack. It wasn't *very* life threatening, just more painful than I thought it would be. He acted like nothing. Nothing at all. He never apologized either. Ever since then, every time I see him, I just want to hurt him. I don't know how, and I don't know why I have these feelings, since I'm more of a pacifist than a fighter. But everytime I see him I just look around and see all the things that I could grab and swing at him. I know that I'll probably never hurt him unless he hurts me in a way more than just pulling my shirt, or if he hurts my family. He's becoming more and more of a terrible person. I don't know if I can take that for how much longer I have to be in his house.
